acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether instruction files get a recognised affected ownership class; if yes, affected stops listing them as unknowns, with a test.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout A (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). Every repo reported `UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH: AGENTS.md` as an unknown. Instruction files are a recognised authority class elsewhere (impact returns them as project-instructions); affected could classify them instead of reporting an unknown. Suspected gap, may be by design. Related: V1-2073.
title: affected reports UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md on every instruction-file change
